desc: Regional EdTech Manager, Amsterdam (owner of the LMS in the asset register)
Companies that buy the corporate LMS to train their own employees, each under an LMS service agreement with a data processing agreement
The clients' employees who take courses (adults, 18 or over), and the clients' training administrators and HR managers
Name, work e-mail, employee ID, department and job title; course enrolments, progress, completion dates and quiz answers and marks; for administrators, name, work e-mail and phone
Learners sign in with their work account, through their employer's single sign-on
Self-paced pages, videos to watch and quizzes. The client's training administrators assign the courses; each quiz answer is marked right or wrong against the course's answer key
The client's training administrators and HR managers; LearnTech's support teams in Amsterdam and Mumbai; LearnTech's cloud hosting provider (EU hosting region)
Until 30 days after the client's contract ends; then erased, with a deletion certificate to the client
Encryption at rest and in transit; single sign-on; role-based access, reviewed every six months (BKB-ADD-36 Section 5: Business Critical asset)
purposes: Run the onboarding and role training each client requires its employees to complete as part of their job
Keep each employee's completion record of the training a law obliges the client to give its staff (anti-bribery, data protection, health and safety), to show the client's regulators
Show each client's HR managers which employees in each department have completed which courses, to plan next year's training budget
E-mail news of new optional courses to learners who ticked “Tell me about new courses” in their LMS profile
flows: A client's training administrator uploads the list of employees to enrol (name, work e-mail, employee ID, department and job title) into the corporate LMS, the learning management system that the Amsterdam office runs in the EU hosting region.
The LMS keeps each employee's course enrolments, progress through each course, completion dates and quiz marks, and shows each client's HR managers a list of completions per department.
The client's training administrators and the courses and seats the client has bought (its entitlements) are kept in the Amsterdam office's customer account records.

Second-line support engineers in Mumbai open learners' LMS records, which the Amsterdam office holds in the EU hosting region, to fix sign-in and enrolment problems, and record each fix on the learner's ticket in the Mumbai office's support desk.
The Mumbai office holds the lists of employees to enrol that clients in India send it, and uploads them into the LMS in the EU hosting region.
Thirty days after a client's contract ends, the LMS erases everything it holds on that client's employees, and the Amsterdam office sends the client a deletion certificate.
